gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=1

This PR adds CSV export to widgets; you are its author, and robin and the acme/reviewers team are also requested as reviewers. It covers CSV download and the header format, defers scheduled exports to acme/widgets#46, deliberately buffers the whole CSV instead of streaming it, and leaves the export screen to acme/export-ui.

Two problems block merging.

1. The exporter writes rows without a header line, so a downloaded file starts with data where the column names should be; the local test export_header in tests/export.test.mjs fails on this (src/export.ts:31).
2. The export guide says exports run nightly, but the button exports only when you click it, so a reader waiting for a nightly file never gets one; a corrected sentence is drafted (docs/export.md:8).

maria's comment about the missing header is correct, and a drafted reply acknowledges it and says the fix is planned (comment-73). The test run on this machine failed, while the build check passed in CI; a required unit check is still running, so merging also waits on it. Of the three items from your previous review, two are addressed. The rebase onto main succeeded and was pushed after one conflict in src/export.ts was resolved. One smaller point does not block merging: the export loop repeats the paging helper's code (src/export.ts:44), and deliver with nits takes it.

I recommend deliver because both problems have repairs the gate can make on your own PR.

Pick one:
1. deliver - repair blockers, rebase on main, watch CI, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. deliver with nits - the same, and also replace the repeated paging code with the shared helper.
3. assess - post both problems to the PR as one review and make no repairs.
4. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
